avds.name: notrios_api35_x86_64
avds.created_with: avdmanager exact image and Pixel 6 profile

supplied_reference_assessments.claim: A coding agent can install SDK images, create an AVD, and run an emulator from the command line.
supplied_reference_assessments.assessment: accurate when permissions, network, disk, and KVM or another acceleration path are available
supplied_reference_assessments.evidence: This run installed two images, created two AVDs, cold-booted API 35 headlessly, used ADB, and stopped it.

supplied_reference_assessments.claim: sdkmanager is deprecated in favor of the android sdk commands.
supplied_reference_assessments.evidence: sdkmanager printed the deprecation notice and pointed to android sdk.

supplied_reference_assessments.assessment: false for the installed android CLI
supplied_reference_assessments.correction: The modern CLI uses slash IDs: system-images/android-35/google_apis/x86_64. avdmanager retains the legacy semicolon form.

android sdk exposes install, update, remove, and list. --licenses is rejected and android sdk install exposes no --accept-licenses option. Existing licenses were already accepted; automatic yes input was supplied during installation as authorized.

supplied_reference_assessments.claim: A persistent .androidrc sdk.accept_licenses setting is the native documented solution.
supplied_reference_assessments.assessment: not supported by the installed help or checked official Android CLI reference

supplied_reference_assessments.claim: android emulator create can pin an exact API/system image.
supplied_reference_assessments.assessment: false for the installed profile-based command
supplied_reference_assessments.correction: It accepts a profile and automatically selected API 36 Google Play. avdmanager was required to create the exact API-35 Google APIs AVD.

supplied_reference_assessments.claim: android run builds, installs, and launches the project.
supplied_reference_assessments.assessment: false for the installed command and official reference
supplied_reference_assessments.correction: android run deploys supplied APK paths and explicitly performs no build steps.

supplied_reference_assessments.claim: JAVA_HOME must be pointed at Android Studio JBR for these CLI tasks.
supplied_reference_assessments.correction: No JAVA_HOME override was used. SDK/AVD commands succeeded with the PATH-selected Temurin 21; Flutter independently continued to use its configured Android Studio JBR.

modernc_runtime.external_linker_note: Go's Android/amd64 executable requires external linking, so CGO_ENABLED=1 and NDK API-35 clang were used even though modernc selected zero CgoFiles.

remaining_limits: No Flutter Android application exists in the current repository, so no APK or Gradle deployment was possible or claimed.
The current direct C Notrios store was not built because its Android SQLite package remains the H0 decision under investigation.
The feasibility executable is not the real versioned Notrios ABI or full schema-v27/store/snapshot/sync suite.
Android/arm64, a physical device, performance A/B against the pinned C control, package/RSS costs, and iOS remain unverified.
